scripts.test:unit: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist-test',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && find dist-test/test/unit -name '*.test.js' | xargs node --test
scripts.test:integration: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist-test',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && find dist-test/test/integration -name '*.test.js' | xargs node --test --test-concurrency=1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
